mapper.select: SELECT dugro.id, ogron.id source_id, ogron.dates, ogron.game_code, ogron.pkg_id, ogron.game_id, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, ogron.s_id, ogron.played_time, ogron.start_time, ogron.end_time, ogron.game_result, ogron.reward_source, ogron.reward_account_type, ogron.reward, ogron.expend, ogron.expend_account_type, ogron.create_time, ogron.end_time FROM ods_game_record_one_net ogron INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = ogron.user_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_game_record_oeta dugro on (dugro.source_id = ogron.id) where ogron.id = #{sourceId}

SELECT dugro.id, t.source_id, t.dates, t.pkg_id, t.game_id, t.user_id, t.s_id, t.played_time, t.game_result, t.reward_source, t.reward_account_type, t.reward, t.expend, t.expend_account_type, t.create_time source_create_time, t.update_time source_update_time, t.game_code, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country FROM (SELECT ogron.id source_id, ogron.dates, ogron.pkg_id, ogron.game_id, ogron.game_code, ogron.user_id, ogron.s_id, ogron.played_time, ogron.start_time, ogron.end_time, ogron.game_result, ogron.reward_source, ogron.reward_account_type, ogron.reward, ogron.expend, ogron.expend_account_type, ogron.create_time, ogron.update_time FROM ods_game_record_one_net ogron where ogron.dates = #{dates} and ogron.id > #{startSourceId} and ogron.id <= #{endSourceId}) t INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = t.user_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_game_record_oeta dugro on (dugro.source_id = t.source_id)
